name: SteamVeil / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A quick pressurized steam valve release, a wide bright white vapor hiss swelling once then fading into a few cooling water droplets. Steam and heat, no organic breathing.
